_설명: 채널 설정. 첫 편 전에 한 번 채우고 편마다 에피소드 폴더에 channel.json 으로 복사한다. 값은 예시다.
title: Hidden Reasons
final_line: And that is how the [subject] came to be.
banned: text, numbers or logos inside images

A.label: 도해
A.suffix: Style: miniature 3D diorama like an illustrated encyclopedia plate, soft studio light, clean pastel palette, tilt-shift depth of field, slow smooth camera. No people.
A.keep: Keep every object and the diorama style exactly the same in every frame.

B.label: 손그림
B.suffix: Style: hand-drawn cartoon on off-white paper, thick black ink outlines, colored-pencil shading with visible strokes. Simple stick-figure adults with big round white heads and dot eyes. Flat 2D, gentle simple animation. No realistic humans.
B.keep: Keep every stick figure exactly as drawn in every frame, same flat drawing style.

X.label: 섞음
X.suffix: Style: mixed media. A hand-drawn paper world where only the key object is photorealistic and glowing. No realistic humans.
X.keep: Keep the characters, the key object and both styles exactly the same in every frame.

refs.cast_sheet.png: Keep the exact same stick-figure characters (faces, clothes, colors) and the exact same drawing style as this reference sheet.

voice.ref_text: [voice_ref.wav 에서 실제로 말하는 문장을 그대로 적는다]
